Listing photos and video, the steadiest source of work.
Seasonal and priced per event, often sold with a ground crew.

props.text: Try the economics of a drone photo business
Fixed costs are covered from project 5 each month; every project after that adds $360 of profit.
Illustrative. Fixed costs cover insurance, gear, software and marketing; project costs cover editing and travel.

items: Cheaper drones with better cameras push basic photo prices down.
Licensing, such as FAA Part 107 in the US, keeps casual competition out of paid work.
Inspection, mapping and thermal imaging grow faster than photography alone.
Clients increasingly want edited video and 3D models, not just photos.
